roadmap.title: New Game — protect every questline
roadmap.description: Recruit the achievement NPCs, collect early covenants and gestures, and advance the mandatory route through the Abyss Watchers while avoiding Pale Tongue rank offerings that would end Sirris's route.

roadmap.title: New Game — finish the Lord of Hollows route
roadmap.description: Complete the late-game bosses and optional areas, collect every available upgrade and base-game collectible, farm convenient covenant drops, and take The Usurpation of Fire ending.

roadmap.title: New Game+ — alternate quests and ending
roadmap.description: Use the second cycle for Yellowfinger Heysel's Proper Bow route, missed transpositions and NPC rewards, NG+ rings, the remaining sorceries and miracles, and The End of Fire.

roadmap.title: New Game++ — final rings and cleanup
roadmap.description: Collect the NG++ ring variants, finish the longest covenant ranks, take To Link the First Flame, and clean up any remaining achievement before the meta unlock.

achievements.sortReason: Expected during New Game++ — final rings and cleanup.
achievements.summary: Unlock the other 42 base-game Steam achievements on the same account.

guide.context: Neither DLC contributes achievements: every required ring and spell comes from the base game, not Ashes of Ariandel or The Ringed City.

steps.text: Complete every ending, boss, covenant discovery, upgrade, location, and base-game collection achievement listed in this guide; The Dark Soul unlocks after the final missing Steam achievement.

achievements.description: Reach the To Link the First Flame ending.
achievements.sortReason: Expected during New Game++ — final rings and cleanup.
achievements.summary: Defeat Soul of Cinder, remove every Dark Sigil, and use the Kiln bonfire without summoning the Fire Keeper.

guide.context: The Lord of Hollows state replaces this ending when Dark Sigils remain, while the Fire Keeper's summon sign begins a different ending branch.

steps.text: Place the Abyss Watchers, Aldrich, Yhorm, and Lothric remains on their @loc{Firelink Shrine} thrones; kneel at the shrine bonfire to reach the @loc{Kiln}, then defeat @enemy{Soul of Cinder}.
Confirm that no @item{Dark Sigils} remain, ignore any Fire Keeper summon sign, approach the bonfire after the boss, and choose to link the flame.

achievements.description: Reach The End of Fire ending.
achievements.sortReason: Expected during New Game+ — alternate quests and ending.
achievements.summary: Give the Eyes of a Fire Keeper to the Fire Keeper, defeat Soul of Cinder, summon her at the Kiln bonfire, and leave her unharmed.

guide.context: Attacking the Fire Keeper during the final scene produces an alternate conclusion without this achievement, so stop all inputs after summoning her.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Oceiros}, reveal the wall behind the chest beyond his room, enter @loc{Untended Graves}, defeat @enemy{Champion Gundyr}, and reach dark @loc{Firelink Shrine}.
Strike the wall where Irina normally sits, take the @item{Eyes of a Fire Keeper}, return to the normal shrine, and hand that item to the @npc{Fire Keeper}.
Defeat @enemy{Soul of Cinder}, activate the Fire Keeper's summon sign beside the Kiln bonfire, and do not attack her while the ending plays.

achievements.description: Reach The Usurpation of Fire ending.
achievements.sortReason: Expected during New Game — protect every questline.
achievements.summary: Take Yoel's five Draw Out True Strength levels before Abyss Watchers, complete Anri's Darkmoon Tomb rite to hold eight Dark Sigils, then link the flame at the Kiln bonfire to usurp it after Soul of Cinder.

guide.context: Missing Yoel's fifth Draw Out True Strength level before the Abyss Watchers prevents Yuria from opening the eight-Dark-Sigil route during that cycle.

steps.text: Recruit @npc{Yoel} from the pilgrims below Foot of the High Wall, choose Draw Out True Strength five times as Hollowing rises, and finish all five levels before defeating the @enemy{Abyss Watchers}.

After Yoel dies, speak with @npc{Yuria}; meet @npc{Anri} at Halfway Fortress, after Deacons in Firelink, twice in the Catacombs, and at Church of Yorshka, while leaving the hidden pilgrim in the church alive.
Defeat @enemy{Pontiff Sulyvahn}, speak with Yuria, enter @loc{Darkmoon Tomb} below Anor Londo, receive the Sword of Avowal, and perform the rite with Anri to reach eight @item{Dark Sigils}.
Defeat @enemy{Soul of Cinder} with all eight Dark Sigils still in the inventory, approach the Kiln bonfire, and link the flame to usurp it.

achievements.description: Defeat the Abyss Watchers, Lords of Cinder.
achievements.sortReason: Expected during New Game — protect every questline.
achievements.summary: Extinguish the three Farron Keep flames, open the stone gate, and defeat the Abyss Watchers.

guide.context: Opening the Catacombs after this fight kills Yoel, which makes the five pre-Catacombs Dark Sigils the important route checkpoint.

steps.text: From @loc{Farron Keep}, extinguish all three hilltop flames, pass through the opened stone doors, enter the church beyond Farron Keep Perimeter, and defeat @enemy{Abyss Watchers} in both phases.

achievements.displayName: Lord of Cinder: Yhorm the Giant
achievements.description: Defeat Yhorm the Giant, Lord of Cinder.
achievements.sortReason: Expected during New Game — finish the Lord of Hollows route.
achievements.summary: Reach the Profaned Capital throne room and defeat Yhorm the Giant with Storm Ruler's charged weapon skill.

guide.context: Siegward joins this battle only if his quest reached the Irithyll Dungeon prison rescue; Storm Ruler remains available in the arena either way.

steps.text: Enter @loc{Profaned Capital} through Irithyll Dungeon, cross to Yhorm's throne room, collect @item{Storm Ruler} beside the throne, hold its weapon skill until fully charged, and release the heavy attack until @enemy{Yhorm the Giant} is defeated.

achievements.displayName: Lord of Cinder: Aldrich, Devourer of Gods
achievements.description: Defeat Aldrich, Devourer of Gods, Lord of Cinder.
achievements.sortReason: Expected during New Game — finish the Lord of Hollows route.
achievements.summary: Traverse Irithyll beyond Pontiff, reach Anor Londo, and defeat Aldrich in the cathedral.

guide.context: The route passes the Water Reserve and Prison Tower covenant branches, so collect both before finishing the Anor Londo objective.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Pontiff Sulyvahn}, cross the giant courtyard and rooftops, raise the rotating tower, enter @loc{Anor Londo}, open the cathedral, and defeat @enemy{Aldrich, Devourer of Gods}.

achievements.displayName: Lord of Cinder: Lothric, Younger Prince
achievements.description: Defeat Lothric, Younger Prince, Lord of Cinder.
achievements.sortReason: Expected during New Game — finish the Lord of Hollows route.
achievements.summary: Open the Grand Archives after gathering the other three Lords' cinders, then defeat Lorian and Lothric in the royal palace.

guide.context: The Grand Archives door stays sealed until the Abyss Watchers, Aldrich, and Yhorm have all fallen; the second phase revives Lorian until Lothric is defeated.

steps.text: Defeat the @enemy{Abyss Watchers}, @enemy{Aldrich}, and @enemy{Yhorm}; defeat Dragonslayer Armour, take the Grand Archives Key, traverse the archives and palace bridge, then defeat @enemy{Lorian} and @enemy{Lothric} in the two-phase fight.

achievements.description: Reinforce any weapon to the highest level.
achievements.sortReason: Expected during New Game — finish the Lord of Hollows route.
achievements.summary: Reinforce a standard Titanite weapon to +10 at Andre with 36 upgrade stones and one Titanite Slab.

guide.context: Weapons using Twinkling Titanite or Titanite Scales stop at +5, so a normal Titanite weapon provides the clearest route to the stated +10 maximum.

steps.text: Gather twelve stones from each regular tier: @item{Titanite Shard}, @item{Large Titanite Shard}, and @item{Titanite Chunk}. Add one @item{Titanite Slab}, then choose Reinforce Weapon with @npc{Andre} until a normal weapon reaches +10.

achievements.sortReason: Expected during New Game — finish the Lord of Hollows route.
achievements.summary: Deliver Farron Coal, Sage's Coal, Profaned Coal, and Giant's Coal to Andre, then apply all 15 infusion types to separate weapons.

guide.context: Use 15 separate weapons and pause between infusions so the achievement counter has a clean record; naturally pre-infused gear does not supply credit.

collectibles.name: Refined
collectibles.method: Kill the blue-clad @enemy{Lothric Knight} outside Emma's cathedral for a @item{Refined Gem}, then choose Refined at Andre's Infuse Weapon menu.

collectibles.name: Raw
collectibles.method: From @loc{Dragon Barracks}, drop beneath the left wyvern, take the side patio pickup for a @item{Raw Gem}, and apply Raw at Andre.

collectibles.name: Fire
collectibles.method: Help @npc{Siegward} defeat the Fire Demon below the elevator tower to receive a @item{Fire Gem}, then apply Fire at Andre.

collectibles.name: Heavy
collectibles.method: After Curse-rotted Greatwood, exhaust @npc{Hawkwood}'s dialogue for a @item{Heavy Gem}. Retrieve @item{Farron Coal} from the Black Knight room at Crucifixion Woods' far-right boundary, give the coal to Andre, and apply Heavy.

collectibles.name: Sharp
collectibles.method: Find the @item{Sharp Gem} beside the hidden room holding the Carthus Pyromancy Tome; give Andre the @item{Farron Coal} and apply Sharp.

collectibles.name: Poison
collectibles.method: Loot the @item{Poison Gem} guarded by three Elder Ghru, or farm Rotten Slugs; give Andre the @item{Farron Coal} and apply Poison.

collectibles.name: Crystal
collectibles.method: Kill the Crystal Lizard in the Crucifixion Woods ruins for a @item{Crystal Gem}. In Farron Keep, defeat the Darkwraith guarding the small tower left of the first flame for @item{Sage's Coal}; give it to Andre and apply Crystal.

collectibles.name: Blessed
collectibles.method: Cross the cathedral rafters and loot the corpse beside the greatsword Cathedral Knight for a @item{Blessed Gem}; give Andre the @item{Sage's Coal} and apply Blessed.

collectibles.name: Deep
collectibles.method: Take the stairs beside the first large interior hall and loot the balcony guarded by an Evangelist for a @item{Deep Gem}; give Andre the @item{Sage's Coal} and apply Deep.

collectibles.name: Dark
collectibles.method: Kill the hat-wearing skeleton controlling the second rolling skeleton ball and collect the released @item{Dark Gem}. Loot @item{Profaned Coal} from the first large left-side cell on Irithyll Dungeon's ground floor, give it to Andre, and apply Dark.

collectibles.name: Blood
collectibles.method: Beyond Church of Yorshka, loot the corpse at the lone tree surrounded by slaves for a @item{Blood Gem}; give Andre the @item{Profaned Coal} and apply Blood.

collectibles.name: Hollow
collectibles.method: Drop through the wall opening below Farron Keep Perimeter and loot the second corpse on the descending path for a @item{Hollow Gem}; give Andre the @item{Profaned Coal} and apply Hollow.

collectibles.name: Lightning
collectibles.method: Collect the @item{Lightning Gem} from the floor-level corpse at the altar below Pontiff's cathedral. Loot @item{Giant's Coal} from the dead Giant Blacksmith in Anor Londo, give it to Andre, and apply Lightning.

collectibles.name: Simple
collectibles.method: Loot the open second-floor cell containing a hostile Wretch for a @item{Simple Gem}; give Andre the @item{Giant's Coal} and apply Simple.

collectibles.name: Chaos
collectibles.method: Loot the @item{Chaos Gem} behind the three Embered Great Crabs at the far wall; give Andre the @item{Giant's Coal} and apply Chaos.

achievements.sortReason: Expected during New Game++ — final rings and cleanup.
achievements.summary: Hold all 107 required base-game ring variants on one character through NG++.

guide.context: The set includes separate +1 and +2 variants but excludes DLC rings; covenant ranks and NPC quest conflicts make the checklist safer than relying on inventory count alone.

collectibles.method: Free @npc{Greirat} with the Cell Key and accept his request to deliver a ring to Loretta.

collectibles.name: Ring of Sacrifice
collectibles.method: Beyond the Winged Knight courtyard, climb the right stairs and jump from the overlook to the corpse on the wooden awning.

collectibles.name: Flame Stoneplate Ring
collectibles.method: Near the passive cage-bearer, cut down the hanging corpse so that it lands on the ledge rather than falling below.

collectibles.name: Fire Clutch Ring
collectibles.method: Cross the gallows beyond the stable and loot the corpse at the end of the wooden walkway over the chasm.

collectibles.name: Bloodbite Ring
collectibles.method: Enter the sewer beside the small stone bridge near Cliff Underside and kill the Giant Rat.

collectibles.name: Pontiff's Left Eye
collectibles.method: Give @npc{Ludleth} the Transposing Kiln and transpose the @item{Soul of Boreal Valley Vordt}.

collectibles.name: Saint's Ring
collectibles.method: Rescue @npc{Irina} and buy Saint's Ring from her for 300 souls.
collectibles.note: Buy this before completing Irina's good route.

collectibles.name: Flynn's Ring
collectibles.method: Beyond the Fire Demon, climb onto the stone building roof and loot the corpse on the raised wooden platform.

collectibles.name: Chloranthy Ring
collectibles.method: From the rooftop holding Flynn's Ring beyond Siegward's Fire Demon, drop to the nearby stone tower, descend inside, break the ground-floor crates, and loot the hidden corpse.

collectibles.name: Untrue Dark Ring
collectibles.method: Make @npc{Yuria} appear by receiving five Dark Sigils from Yoel, then buy the ring for 5,000 souls.

collectibles.name: Untrue White Ring
collectibles.method: Make @npc{Yuria} appear by receiving five Dark Sigils from Yoel, then buy the ring for 5,000 souls.

collectibles.name: Covetous Silver Serpent Ring
collectibles.method: Reach the rafters from the roof, strike the wall above Lothric's throne, drop to the ledge, and open the chest.

collectibles.name: Estus Ring
collectibles.method: Use the Tower Key, enter the bell tower, and descend the projecting coffins to the corpse on the floor.

collectibles.name: Morne's Ring
collectibles.method: Before Halfway Fortress, drop from the bridge beside the tree and loot the corpse inside the cave guarded by two hounds.

collectibles.name: Great Swamp Ring
collectibles.method: Kill the Great Crab straight ahead from Halfway Fortress; Pyromancers can also drop and reclaim their starting copy.

collectibles.name: Sage Ring
collectibles.method: From the bonfire, enter the flooded passage on the left and loot the corpse along the right wall of the Lycanthrope room.

collectibles.name: Poisonbite Ring
collectibles.method: Descend from the Cleansing Chapel obelisk to the stream and follow the narrow interior passage to the corpse guarded by a Corpse Grub.

collectibles.name: Lloyd's Sword Ring
collectibles.method: While crossing the ledge beside the first giant, enter the right alcove and loot the rear corpse.

collectibles.name: Aldrich's Sapphire
collectibles.method: Defeat the Deep Accursed that ambushes the square room beyond the lower Cathedral Knight.

collectibles.name: Deep Ring
collectibles.method: Use the elevator near the second Cleansing Chapel shortcut, climb the outside ladder, and kill the lone deacon atop the tower.

collectibles.name: Lloyd's Shield Ring
collectibles.method: Give Paladin's Ashes to the @npc{Shrine Handmaid} and buy the ring for 2,500 souls.

collectibles.name: Horsehoof Ring
collectibles.method: Advance @npc{Patches} to Firelink, exhaust his dialogue, and buy the ring for 500 souls; killing Patches also drops it.

collectibles.name: Lingering Dragoncrest Ring
collectibles.method: From Keep Ruins, enter the left swamp and kill the Great Crab beside the white birch.

collectibles.name: Havel's Ring
collectibles.method: Give @npc{Ludleth} the @item{Soul of a Stray Demon} plus 5,000 souls and transpose the ring.

collectibles.name: Life Ring
collectibles.method: Give Dreamchaser's Ashes to the @npc{Shrine Handmaid} and buy Life Ring for 1,500 souls; a burial-gift copy can be dropped and reclaimed.

collectibles.name: Young Dragon Ring
collectibles.method: Give @npc{Orbeck} both Sage's Scroll and Golden Scroll, buy additional sorceries if needed, and exhaust his dialogue.

collectibles.name: Slumbering Dragoncrest Ring
collectibles.method: After giving Orbeck both early scrolls, purchase Spook, Pestilent Mist, Hidden Body, Farron Flashsword, and Aural Decoy, then speak with him.

collectibles.name: Farron Ring
collectibles.method: Defeat the Abyss Watchers and exhaust @npc{Hawkwood}'s dialogue.

collectibles.name: Hawk Ring
collectibles.method: Collect all seven Young White Branches and return to the giant archer's corpse, or kill the giant and loot the ring.

collectibles.name: Carthus Milkring
collectibles.method: After the first bridge, follow the main hall and loot the corpse at the rear of the first urn-filled alcove.

collectibles.name: Carthus Bloodring
collectibles.method: From the bonfire, descend past the second rolling skeleton ball, turn right, and follow the wheel-skeleton hall to the dead-end corpse.

collectibles.name: Witch's Ring
collectibles.method: Cut Wolnir's rope bridge, climb down it, pass the Fire Demon and Mimic, and loot the corpse before Abandoned Tomb.

collectibles.name: Speckled Stoneplate Ring
collectibles.method: From Abandoned Tomb, cross the water toward the opposite boundary and make the giant ballista destroy the unusual stone wall.

collectibles.name: Knight Slayer's Ring
collectibles.method: Defeat @npc{Knight Slayer Tsorig} in the passage beyond the basilisk nest; his Catacombs phantom can also award it.

collectibles.name: Ring of the Evil Eye
collectibles.method: Kill Horace in Smouldering Lake before Wolnir, then tell @npc{Anri} where Horace was found.

collectibles.name: Pontiff's Right Eye
collectibles.method: Kill the Sulyvahn's Beast that attacks while crossing the bridge into Irithyll.

collectibles.name: Magic Clutch Ring
collectibles.method: At the Church of Yorshka route altar, strike the wall beside the short staircase and loot the overlook corpse.

collectibles.name: Leo Ring
collectibles.method: Beyond the sewer kitchen, climb to the second floor and open the chest after the two Silver Knights.

collectibles.name: Ring of the Sun's First Born
collectibles.method: Open Pontiff's shortcut, walk to the overlook opposite his fog gate, and drop onto the altar below.

collectibles.name: Silvercat Ring
collectibles.method: Help @npc{Sirris} defeat Creighton from her summon sign on the Irithyll bridge, then exhaust her dialogue in Firelink.

collectibles.name: Dark Stoneplate Ring
collectibles.method: Follow the left wall beneath the first raised walkway and loot the corpse at the lower dead end.

collectibles.name: Ring of Favor
collectibles.method: Reveal the wall below the tower stairs after Pontiff, descend the ladder, and kill both Sulyvahn's Beasts.

collectibles.name: Reversal Ring
collectibles.method: Open the chest hidden to the right of the dais used for Anri's rite.

collectibles.name: Aldrich's Ruby
collectibles.method: Kill the Deep Accursed that drops from the ceiling while opening the cathedral's front doors.

collectibles.name: Sun Princess Ring
collectibles.method: After Aldrich, ride either arena lift upward and collect the ring on the step inside Gwynevere's chamber.

collectibles.name: Wood Grain Ring
collectibles.method: Give Easterner's Ashes to the @npc{Shrine Handmaid} and buy the ring for 3,000 souls.

collectibles.name: Obscuring Ring
collectibles.method: Offer 10 @item{Pale Tongues} to Rosaria; earn them through invasions or farm the Darkwraiths outside Farron Keep Perimeter.

collectibles.name: Bellowing Dragoncrest Ring
collectibles.method: Use the Jailbreaker's Key on the third-floor exterior door, then drop two ledges to the corpse.

collectibles.name: Dark Clutch Ring
collectibles.method: Beyond the sleeping giant, follow the sewer to its end and kill the Mimic on the left.

collectibles.name: Dusk Crown Ring
collectibles.method: On the large ground-floor cell block, enter the final left-side cell and loot the rear corpse.

collectibles.name: Cursebite Ring
collectibles.method: Cross from the bonfire tower into the toxic-swamp building and loot the corpse in the cave below the wooden walkway.

collectibles.name: Covetous Gold Serpent Ring
collectibles.method: Use the Old Cell Key to free @npc{Siegward} and loot the second corpse inside his cell.

collectibles.name: Dragonscale Ring
collectibles.method: Use the rear garden elevator shortcut, step onto its intermediate floor, and follow the stairs to the corpse.

collectibles.name: Magic Stoneplate Ring
collectibles.method: Defeat the greatsword-wielding Cathedral Knight stationed above Oceiros's fog gate.

collectibles.name: Ashen Estus Ring
collectibles.method: From the bonfire, follow the left branch back to the starting sarcophagus and loot the corpse inside.

collectibles.name: Hornet Ring
collectibles.method: After Champion Gundyr, turn right before dark Firelink and loot the corpse at the grave down the path.

collectibles.name: Priestess Ring
collectibles.method: Buy the ring from the dark shrine's @npc{Shrine Handmaid} for 1,000 souls.

collectibles.name: Prisoner's Chain
collectibles.method: Give @npc{Ludleth} the @item{Soul of Champion Gundyr} and transpose Prisoner's Chain.

collectibles.name: Red Tearstone Ring
collectibles.method: At the building beside Dragonslayer Armour's fog gate, pass the inactive elevator and loot the right balcony.

collectibles.name: Knight's Ring
collectibles.method: Climb onto the roof left of the Dragonslayer Armour approach, descend into the far building, and loot beside the bookshelf.

collectibles.name: Scholar's Ring
collectibles.method: At the near end of the upper bridge, pull the shortcut lever and loot the revealed wax scholar.

collectibles.name: Fleshbite Ring
collectibles.method: Beyond the upper bridge shortcut, climb the next stone stairs and loot the corpse in the right-hand cursed-book section.

collectibles.name: Hunter's Ring
collectibles.method: After defeating the three Ascended Winged Knights, climb the central tower ladder and loot the corpse by the broken railing.

collectibles.name: Skull Ring
collectibles.method: After the five Lords' remains burn on their thrones, collect Skull Ring from @npc{Ludleth}'s ashes.

collectibles.name: Lightning Clutch Ring
collectibles.method: At the first large gate, descend the small stairs left of the lever and loot the corpse beyond the Man-serpent.

collectibles.name: Ring of Steel Protection
collectibles.method: After the boss, return to the arena, descend beside the raised bell, circle behind the railing, and loot the column-side corpse.

collectibles.name: Calamity Ring
collectibles.method: Use Path of the Dragon before the fossilized wyvern altar at the bottom of the first chamber and wait for the reward.

collectibles.name: Thunder Stoneplate Ring
collectibles.method: Beyond the axe-wielding Man-serpent ambush, cross to the separate wooden platform and climb the pillar ladder.

collectibles.name: Wolf Ring
collectibles.method: Offer 30 @item{Wolf's Blood Swordgrass}; invade as a Watchdog or farm the Ghru near Keep Ruins or Farron Keep Perimeter.

collectibles.name: Speckled Stoneplate Ring +1
collectibles.method: Enter the side area containing the Ravenous Crystal Lizard and loot the corpse immediately on the right.

collectibles.name: Fleshbite Ring +1
collectibles.method: From the Pus of Man roof, jump from the ladder toward the corpse on the adjacent roof.

collectibles.name: Poisonbite Ring +1
collectibles.method: From Dilapidated Bridge, pass the white birch and loot the corpse behind the well beside the hilltop hovel.

collectibles.name: Life Ring +1
collectibles.method: At Siegward's middle elevator stop, loot the corpse in the alcove directly behind his sitting place.

collectibles.name: Lingering Dragoncrest Ring +1
collectibles.method: Loot the corpse behind the tree near the left-side Great Crab, facing the two Exile Knights.

collectibles.name: Ring of the Evil Eye +1
collectibles.method: Loot the corpse against the monument immediately outside the Deacons of the Deep approach.

collectibles.name: Magic Stoneplate Ring +1
collectibles.method: From Farron Keep bonfire, wade right into deep water and loot the corpse shortly beyond Iron Flesh.

collectibles.name: Wolf Ring +1
collectibles.method: Face the three-Ghru bridge, circle around the right side of the bonfire tower, and loot the corpse against its wall.

collectibles.name: Thunder Stoneplate Ring +1
collectibles.method: Beyond the first rolling skeleton ball, loot the corpse in the urn-filled alcove that held Carthus Milkring in NG.

collectibles.name: Bloodbite Ring +1
collectibles.method: Reach the giant ballista above Demon Ruins and loot the corpse leaning against the weapon.

collectibles.name: Chloranthy Ring +1
collectibles.method: From Church of Yorshka, return to the altar below Pontiff's cathedral and loot the corpse behind it.

collectibles.name: Covetous Gold Serpent Ring +1
collectibles.method: Beyond Church of Yorshka's dark slave room, drop through the right-hand railing and loot the corpse against the wall.

collectibles.name: Ring of Favor +1
collectibles.method: Cross the upper bridge inside Pontiff's cathedral and loot the corpse hidden behind the final pillar in the dead-end hall.

collectibles.name: Covetous Silver Serpent Ring +1
collectibles.method: Use the elevator beside the sleeping giant and step onto the platform near the bottom of its shaft.

collectibles.name: Havel's Ring +1
collectibles.method: From Great Belfry, climb the left hill through two stone arches and loot the corpse before the long altar stairs.

collectibles.name: Flame Stoneplate Ring +1
collectibles.method: Climb onto the toxic-swamp building's first roof, then drop from its left edge to the lower roof corpse.

collectibles.name: Wood Grain Ring +1
collectibles.method: Ride the first garden elevator to the bottom and loot the corpse directly behind its landing point in the toxic ground.

collectibles.name: Ring of Steel Protection +1
collectibles.method: In dark Firelink's upper exterior, loot the corpse to the right of the tower opened by the Tower Key.

collectibles.name: Life Ring +2
collectibles.method: From Dragon Barracks, drop under the right wyvern, climb to the Pus of Man, exit outside, and drop below the hanging corpse.

collectibles.name: Dark Stoneplate Ring +1
collectibles.method: Left of the Dragonslayer Armour fog gate, drop to the Pus of Man, enter the side room, climb up, and loot the right balcony.

collectibles.name: Sage Ring +1
collectibles.method: Reach the central rooftop tower, descend to the stone rafters, and loot the wall-side corpse opposite the Man-grub.

collectibles.name: Darkmoon Ring
collectibles.method: Offer 10 @item{Proofs of a Concord Kept} to @npc{Company Captain Yorshka}; earn them as a Darkmoon Blade or farm Anor Londo Silver Knights.

collectibles.name: Wolf Ring +2
collectibles.method: Defeat Iudex Gundyr, open the stone exit doors, and loot the corpse immediately on the left.

collectibles.name: Ring of the Evil Eye +2
collectibles.method: Enter the large room below the Pus of Man roof and loot the corpse behind barrels in the far-left corner.

collectibles.name: Covetous Silver Serpent Ring +2
collectibles.method: Beyond the Fire Demon, drop from the roof near Flynn's Ring to the A-frame roof and then the long lower roof.

collectibles.name: Chloranthy Ring +2
collectibles.method: At the first Corvian storyteller, look left of its tree and drop to the corpse on the ledge below.

collectibles.name: Ring of Favor +2
collectibles.method: Use the second Cleansing Chapel shortcut elevator, climb to the roofs, turn left atop the arch, and loot the great-axe Hollow's alcove.

collectibles.name: Dark Stoneplate Ring +2
collectibles.method: Cross the three-Ghru bridge from Keep Ruins, circle left around the ruins, break the wooden graves, and loot the corner corpse.

collectibles.name: Ring of Steel Protection +2
collectibles.method: At the far end of the first bridge, drop left to the pillar holding the corpse.

collectibles.name: Flame Stoneplate Ring +2
collectibles.method: From Old King's Antechamber, reach the crossroad, strike the left dead-end wall, pass the Black Knight, and loot behind the Taurus Demon pile.

collectibles.name: Wood Grain Ring +2
collectibles.method: Exit the Silver Knight manor after the sewer kitchen, turn immediately right, and loot around the building corner.

collectibles.name: Havel's Ring +2
collectibles.method: Cross the invisible path before Anor Londo, then descend five rafter levels from Prison Tower to the corpse above the Painting Guardian set.

collectibles.name: Magic Stoneplate Ring +2
collectibles.method: Descend from the bonfire tower, turn right after the wall opening, and loot beneath the overhang at the broken stair's end.

collectibles.name: Sage Ring +2
collectibles.method: Step off the first elevator at its upper platform, drop to the stairs above the toxic floor, and jump left to the adjacent corpse.

collectibles.name: Life Ring +3
collectibles.method: Enter dark Firelink after Champion Gundyr and loot the corpse hidden behind Lothric's throne.

collectibles.name: Thunder Stoneplate Ring +2
collectibles.method: At the inactive lift beside Dragonslayer Armour, exit left, drop to the roof, turn around, and loot behind the final window arch.

collectibles.name: Lingering Dragoncrest Ring +2
collectibles.method: At the Winged Knight roof, climb the central tower's short stairs and loot the alcove opposite the ladder.

collectibles.name: Covetous Gold Serpent Ring +2
collectibles.method: Defeat the Nameless King in NG++, then loot the corpse up the small stairs on the right side of the cleared arena.

achievements.sortReason: Expected during New Game+ — alternate quests and ending.
achievements.summary: Retain the seven starting gestures and learn all 26 checklist gestures; finish Sirris's route in NG, then in NG+ defeat Yellowfinger Heysel while Embered in the Crucifixion Woods swamp, offer Rosaria one Pale Tongue in Rosaria's Bed Chamber, and summon Heysel while Embered near Keep Ruins before the Abyss Watchers.

guide.context: Proper Bow requires a Pale Tongue offering that ends Sirris's quest, so finish Sirris's Darkmoon Loyalty and Silvercat Ring route before pursuing Yellowfinger Heysel.

collectibles.name: Rest
collectibles.method: Choose the Rest command during your first bonfire visit.

collectibles.name: Collapse
collectibles.method: Exhaust @npc{Hawkwood}'s opening dialogue.

collectibles.name: Hurrah!
collectibles.method: Exhaust @npc{Andre}'s opening dialogue.

collectibles.name: Beckon
collectibles.method: Recruit @npc{Yoel} from Foot of the High Wall and exhaust his dialogue in the shrine.

collectibles.name: Welcome
collectibles.method: Recruit @npc{Cornyx}, end the first conversation, then speak with him again.

collectibles.name: Prayer
collectibles.method: Open Irina's cell with the Grave Key and choose to touch @npc{Irina}.

collectibles.name: Curl Up
collectibles.method: Give @npc{Greirat} Loretta's Bone, reload the shrine, and speak with him while he is curled up.

collectibles.name: Toast
collectibles.method: Help @npc{Siegward} defeat the Fire Demon and speak with him afterward.

collectibles.name: Sleep
collectibles.method: After Siegward's toast, speak with him again while he sleeps.

collectibles.name: Applause
collectibles.method: Obtain the Red Eye Orb and return to @npc{Leonhard}.

collectibles.name: Dignified Bow
collectibles.method: Receive five Dark Sigils from Yoel before the Abyss Watchers, reload after Yoel dies, and speak with @npc{Yuria}.

collectibles.name: Call Over
collectibles.method: Complete an initial crow-nest trade by leaving a @item{Homeward Bone}; another accepted trade item also works.

collectibles.name: Prostration
collectibles.method: After Patches lowers the bridge, confront @npc{Patches} and answer 'You know who I am'; his Firelink encounter provides a second chance.

collectibles.name: Rejoice
collectibles.method: Buy all four Catarina armor pieces from Patches and throw the set to @npc{Siegward} in the well.

collectibles.name: Legion Etiquette
collectibles.method: Approach the sleeping wolf and select Pray to Old Wolf.

collectibles.name: Silent Ally
collectibles.method: Give Orbeck Sage's Scroll; buy Aural Decoy, Farron Flashsword, Pestilent Mist, and Spook; then speak with @npc{Orbeck}.

collectibles.name: Patches Squat
collectibles.method: Reload after @npc{Patches} becomes a merchant and speak with him while he is squatting.

collectibles.name: Duel Bow
collectibles.method: With five Dark Sigils and Ember form, summon the @npc{Londor Pale Shade} by the bonfire before the Abyss Watchers.

collectibles.name: By My Sword
collectibles.method: While embered before the boss, summon @npc{Black Hand Gotthard} on the middle stair landing.

collectibles.name: Darkmoon Loyalty
collectibles.method: Give Dreamchaser's Ashes to the Shrine Handmaid, reload until @npc{Sirris} returns, and exhaust Sirris's dialogue.

collectibles.name: My Thanks!
collectibles.method: Trigger @npc{Knight Slayer Tsorig}'s invasion near the bonfire; the gesture is awarded whether you defeat him or he defeats you.

collectibles.name: Quiet Resolve
collectibles.method: Advance Anri through the Catacombs and exhaust @npc{Anri}'s dialogue beside the bonfire.

collectibles.name: Stretch Out
collectibles.method: Loot the Undead Bone Shard from Laddersmith Gilligan's corpse beside the bonfire.

collectibles.name: Path of the Dragon
collectibles.method: Defeat Oceiros, open the doors beyond his bonfire, and inspect the seated Drakeblood Knight.

collectibles.name: Praise the Sun
collectibles.method: Pray at the broken Altar of Sunlight in the room near the Dragonslayer Armour approach.

collectibles.name: Proper Bow
collectibles.method: In NG+, become Embered and defeat Yellowfinger Heysel in the far-left @loc{Crucifixion Woods} swamp. Offer Rosaria one Pale Tongue in @loc{Rosaria's Bed Chamber}. Become Embered again and descend from Keep Ruins toward the stone doors; Heysel's summon sign is beside the ramp on its right, immediately before the adjacent tower. Summon her before defeating the Abyss Watchers.
collectibles.note: Offering the Pale Tongue ends Sirris's route, so collect Silvercat Ring and Darkmoon Loyalty in NG first.

achievements.description: Reinforce a bonfire to the highest level.
achievements.sortReason: Expected during New Game — finish the Lord of Hollows route.
achievements.summary: Collect all 10 Undead Bone Shards and burn every shard at Firelink Shrine to reach bonfire level 11.

guide.context: Bonfire level measures flask potency, not flask count; only the Firelink Shrine bonfire accepts the Burn Undead Bone Shard command.

collectibles.name: Undead Bone Shard 1
collectibles.method: From Dilapidated Bridge, pass the giant's white birch and jump to the isolated platform on the right.

collectibles.name: Undead Bone Shard 2
collectibles.method: Near the graveyard white birch, loot the corpse laid across a tomb at the cliff edge.

collectibles.name: Undead Bone Shard 3
collectibles.method: From Keep Ruins, descend toward the stone gate and loot the corpse inside the slug-filled tower on the right.

collectibles.name: Undead Bone Shard 4
collectibles.method: Kill the hat-wearing skeleton beside the first rolling skeleton ball, then let the ball shatter at the lower gate.

collectibles.name: Undead Bone Shard 5
collectibles.method: Kill the @enemy{Carthus Sandworm}; the shard drops together with Lightning Stake.

collectibles.name: Undead Bone Shard 6
collectibles.method: From Demon Ruins bonfire, clear the long room and loot the corpse beneath the dead Stray Demon in the left alcove.

collectibles.name: Undead Bone Shard 7
collectibles.method: From Church of Yorshka, enter the graveyard and loot behind the large grave watched by a Corvian.

collectibles.name: Undead Bone Shard 8
collectibles.method: Climb the tower ladder and loot Laddersmith Gilligan's corpse beside the bonfire.

collectibles.name: Undead Bone Shard 9
collectibles.method: From Dragon Barracks, cross halfway onto the twin-wyvern bridge, drop from the left edge, and loot beneath the bridge.

collectibles.name: Undead Bone Shard 10
collectibles.method: After the rooftop gargoyle, enter the upper walkway and loot the seated wax scholar beyond the small wax pool.

achievements.description: Reinforce the Estus Flask to the highest level.
achievements.sortReason: Expected during New Game — finish the Lord of Hollows route.
achievements.summary: Collect all 11 Estus Shards and give every shard to Andre to reach 15 combined Estus and Ashen Estus charges.

guide.context: Andre increases the shared flask total, while Allocate Estus only changes the split between orange and blue charges.

collectibles.name: Estus Shard 1
collectibles.method: From Tower on the Wall, cross the Pus of Man roof, descend into the large lower room, and loot the wall-side pedestal.

collectibles.name: Estus Shard 2
collectibles.method: Loot the corpse at the base of the burning tree surrounded by peasants and an Evangelist.

collectibles.name: Estus Shard 3
collectibles.method: Buy the Tower Key or use the roof jump, enter the shrine rafters from the crow nest, and loot the hanging corpse on the left.

collectibles.name: Estus Shard 4
collectibles.method: From Crucifixion Woods, follow the upper path to the ordinary bonfire beneath the bridge and loot the corpse to its left.

collectibles.name: Estus Shard 5
collectibles.method: Loot the corpse beside the obelisk immediately outside Cleansing Chapel.

collectibles.name: Estus Shard 6
collectibles.method: Follow the swamp left from Farron Keep bonfire and loot the corpse beside the sunken tower.

collectibles.name: Estus Shard 7
collectibles.method: Reveal the wall in the right corner of Old King's Antechamber and loot the corpse in the left branch of the hidden hall.

collectibles.name: Estus Shard 8
collectibles.method: Inside the cathedral, descend toward the sealed front doors and open the chest behind the right-hand stairwell.

collectibles.name: Estus Shard 9
collectibles.method: After dropping beyond the sleeping giant, enter the next building and kill the Mimic immediately on the right.

collectibles.name: Estus Shard 10
collectibles.method: Ride the first garden elevator down, step onto the intermediate floor, and loot the outside balcony.

collectibles.name: Estus Shard 11
collectibles.method: Beyond the three hostile NPCs, take the left stairs before the palace bridge, reach the Winged Knight roof, and loot the far railing.

achievements.description: Discover the Warrior of Sunlight covenant.
achievements.sortReason: Expected during New Game — protect every questline.
achievements.summary: Collect the Warrior of Sunlight emblem from the locked room near Undead Settlement's burning tree.

guide.context: The covenant can be discovered long before its rank altar becomes available in Lothric Castle; no rank offering is needed for this achievement.

steps.text: From the @loc{Undead Settlement} bonfire, reach the burning tree, enter the building along the left path, break the crates on the right, drop into the closed room, and take the @item{Warrior of Sunlight} emblem from the table.

achievements.description: Discover the Way of Blue covenant.
achievements.sortReason: Expected during New Game — protect every questline.
achievements.summary: Speak with Emma in the High Wall cathedral and accept the Way of Blue covenant item.

guide.context: Way of Blue has no collection reward needed for 100%, so discovering the covenant completes its entire achievement role.

steps.text: Cross the @loc{High Wall of Lothric} Winged Knight courtyard, climb into the cathedral, speak with @npc{Emma}, and accept the @item{Way of Blue} covenant emblem.

achievements.sortReason: Expected during New Game — protect every questline.
achievements.summary: Speak with Horace at Halfway Fortress and accept the Blue Sentinels covenant item.

guide.context: Horace stands beside Anri at the bonfire, making this the same conversation checkpoint that starts Anri's ending route.

steps.text: Reach @loc{Halfway Fortress} in Road of Sacrifices, speak with @npc{Horace the Hushed} beside the bonfire, and accept the @item{Blue Sentinels} covenant emblem.

achievements.description: Discover the Blade of the Darkmoon covenant.
achievements.sortReason: Expected during New Game — finish the Lord of Hollows route.
achievements.summary: Learn Darkmoon Loyalty from Sirris, cross Anor Londo's invisible path, and join Company Captain Yorshka at Prison Tower.

guide.context: Offering a Pale Tongue to Rosaria for covenant rank makes Sirris hostile, so obtain Darkmoon Loyalty before beginning the Rosaria or Heysel rank route.

steps.text: At @loc{Old Wolf of Farron}, circle left from the wall ladder, climb the stairs, reveal the wall immediately on the left, and loot @item{Dreamchaser's Ashes} from the ledge corpse; give the ashes to the Shrine Handmaid.
Reload Firelink after the Abyss Watchers until @npc{Sirris} makes her second shrine visit, then exhaust her dialogue to learn Darkmoon Loyalty.

At the rotating Anor Londo tower, lower the platform, walk straight across the invisible path to the adjacent tower, drop right beside @loc{Prison Tower} bonfire, and speak with @npc{Company Captain Yorshka} to join.

achievements.sortReason: Expected during New Game — protect every questline.
achievements.summary: Cross the Cathedral of the Deep rafters, drop into Rosaria's Bed Chamber, and speak with Rosaria.

guide.context: Joining and using Rosaria's appearance or attribute services does not end Sirris's quest; choosing Offer Pale Tongue for covenant rank does.

steps.text: Reach the upper rafters of @loc{Cathedral of the Deep}, drop from the center section to the far balcony, enter @loc{Rosaria's Bed Chamber}, and speak with @npc{Rosaria} to receive her covenant emblem.

achievements.sortReason: Expected during New Game — protect every questline.
achievements.summary: Before Curse-rotted Greatwood, enter the passive cage-bearer's cage and answer 'Indeed' to Holy Knight Hodrick.

guide.context: Killing Curse-rotted Greatwood removes the early cage transport, so use this route before the boss; a later Sirris route is unnecessary risk for the discovery.

steps.text: From the @loc{Undead Settlement} burning tree, cross the bridge and roofs to the passive Hollow Manservant carrying a cage, approach the cage from behind, and choose Examine.
After arriving in the @loc{Pit of Hollows}, speak with @npc{Holy Knight Hodrick} and answer 'Indeed' to receive the @item{Mound-makers} covenant emblem before fighting Curse-rotted Greatwood.

achievements.description: Discover the Watchdogs of Farron covenant.
achievements.sortReason: Expected during New Game — protect every questline.
achievements.summary: Reach the sleeping wolf above Farron Keep and accept the Watchdogs of Farron covenant.

guide.context: The covenant's achievement requires only discovery, but its Wolf Ring later costs 30 Wolf's Blood Swordgrass.

steps.text: From @loc{Keep Ruins}, descend toward the stone gate, circle right around the tower, ascend the long perimeter-wall ladder, and select Pray to Old Wolf beside the @loc{Old Wolf of Farron} bonfire.

achievements.sortReason: Expected during New Game — finish the Lord of Hollows route.
achievements.summary: Defeat both Sulyvahn's Beasts in the Water Reserve and interact with Archdeacon McDonnell.

guide.context: Great Deep Soul later requires only rank 1, which costs 10 Human Dregs after this discovery.

steps.text: After @enemy{Pontiff Sulyvahn}, cross the giant courtyard, reveal the wall beneath the far tower stairs, descend into @loc{Water Reserve}, kill both @enemy{Sulyvahn's Beasts}, and interact with @npc{Archdeacon McDonnell} in the far-left corner.

achievements.sortReason: Expected during New Game — finish the Lord of Hollows route.
achievements.summary: Defeat Oceiros, reveal the wall behind the chest beyond his arena, and enter Untended Graves.

guide.context: This hidden area mirrors Cemetery of Ash and contains Champion Gundyr, the Eyes of a Fire Keeper, and several required rings.

steps.text: After defeating @enemy{Oceiros}, open the doors beyond his bonfire, pass the seated Drakeblood Knight, strike the wall behind the rear chest, follow the passage, and drop into @loc{Untended Graves} until the area title appears.

achievements.sortReason: Expected during New Game — finish the Lord of Hollows route.
achievements.summary: Use Path of the Dragon on Irithyll Dungeon's empty dragon mat, then follow the transported path into Archdragon Peak.

guide.context: Path of the Dragon comes from the seated Drakeblood Knight beyond Oceiros, so Consumed King's Garden must be completed before the dungeon ritual works.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Oceiros}, open the doors beyond his bonfire, and inspect the seated Drakeblood Knight to learn @mechanic{Path of the Dragon}.

Return to @loc{Irithyll Dungeon}, ride the ground-floor shortcut outside, sit on the empty mat beside the dragon statues, use Path of the Dragon, and follow the transported trail until @loc{Archdragon Peak} appears.

achievements.sortReason: Expected during New Game — protect every questline.
achievements.summary: Pull the Coiled Sword from Iudex Gundyr in Cemetery of Ash and defeat him.

guide.context: The boss also grants Ember form, so the first victory normally unlocks Embrace the Flame at the same time.

steps.text: Reach the arena beyond the first @loc{Cemetery of Ash} bonfire, pull the @item{Coiled Sword} from @enemy{Iudex Gundyr}, and defeat both phases.

achievements.description: Defeat Vordt of the Boreal Valley.
achievements.sortReason: Expected during New Game — protect every questline.
achievements.summary: Descend from Emma's cathedral to the High Wall gatehouse and defeat Vordt of the Boreal Valley.

guide.context: Vordt's soul is needed for Pontiff's Left Eye, so preserve the boss soul until Ludleth receives the Transposing Kiln.

steps.text: From @npc{Emma}'s cathedral on @loc{High Wall of Lothric}, descend the long staircase to the gatehouse, enter the fog gate, and defeat @enemy{Vordt of the Boreal Valley}.

achievements.sortReason: Expected during New Game — protect every questline.
achievements.summary: Enter the Undead Settlement courtyard and destroy Curse-rotted Greatwood's weak growths in both phases.

guide.context: The boss drops the Transposing Kiln but disables the early Mound-makers cage route, so discover that covenant first.

steps.text: After collecting the @item{Mound-makers} emblem, enter the boss courtyard from Dilapidated Bridge or Cliff Underside and attack the pale growths on @enemy{Curse-rotted Greatwood} until both phases end.

achievements.sortReason: Expected during New Game — protect every questline.
achievements.summary: Traverse the Crucifixion Woods ruins and defeat Crystal Sage.

guide.context: The boss soul has two required transpositions across separate cycles: Crystal Sage's Rapier supports covenant farming, while Crystal Hail counts toward the sorcery set.

steps.text: From @loc{Crucifixion Woods}, enter the ruined complex beyond the Exile Knights, follow the upper route to the arena, and defeat @enemy{Crystal Sage}.

achievements.description: Defeat the Deacons of the Deep.
achievements.sortReason: Expected during New Game — protect every questline.
achievements.summary: Open the Cathedral of the Deep's internal shortcuts and defeat the Deacons of the Deep at the main altar.

guide.context: The Deacons' soul transposes into Deep Soul, and their defeat moves Anri to Firelink for the next ending-route conversation.

steps.text: From @loc{Cleansing Chapel}, traverse the graveyard and cathedral, open the interior shortcuts, pass the two giant chambers, enter the altar fog gate, and defeat @enemy{Deacons of the Deep}.

achievements.sortReason: Expected during New Game — protect every questline.
achievements.summary: Cross the Catacombs rope bridge, touch the skull goblet, and break High Lord Wolnir's bracelets.

guide.context: Finish Anri and Horace's Catacombs branch before the fight if you need Ring of the Evil Eye, because advancing past this boss moves Anri onward.

steps.text: In @loc{Catacombs of Carthus}, reach the rope bridge, cross into the chamber beyond, touch the skull goblet, and destroy all three glowing bracelets on @enemy{High Lord Wolnir}.

achievements.sortReason: Expected during New Game — finish the Lord of Hollows route.
achievements.summary: Traverse Irithyll from Central Irithyll to the cathedral and defeat Pontiff Sulyvahn.

guide.context: Several gesture summons appear outside the fog gate only while embered and while their NPC routes remain valid, so collect them before entering.

steps.text: Progress from @loc{Central Irithyll} through Church of Yorshka and the Silver Knight manor, open the cathedral shortcut, and defeat @enemy{Pontiff Sulyvahn}.

achievements.description: Defeat the Dancer of the Boreal Valley.
achievements.sortReason: Expected during New Game — finish the Lord of Hollows route.
achievements.summary: After three Lords of Cinder fall, place the Basin of Vows in Emma's cathedral and defeat the Dancer.

guide.context: Attacking Emma can trigger this late-game boss near the start, but waiting for the teleport after Yhorm preserves the intended difficulty curve.

steps.text: Defeat the @enemy{Abyss Watchers}, @enemy{Aldrich}, and @enemy{Yhorm}; return through the automatic teleport or warp to Emma's cathedral, collect and place the @item{Basin of Vows}, then defeat @enemy{Dancer of the Boreal Valley}.

achievements.sortReason: Expected during New Game — finish the Lord of Hollows route.
achievements.summary: Climb from the Dancer's chamber through Lothric Castle and defeat Dragonslayer Armour on the Grand Archives bridge.

guide.context: Eygon can be summoned while embered, and Sirris is also available if Rosaria rank offerings have not made her hostile.

steps.text: Place the Basin of Vows after the Dancer, climb the ladder, take the straight route through @loc{Lothric Castle} and Dragon Barracks, then enter the bridge fog gate and defeat @enemy{Dragonslayer Armour}.

achievements.sortReason: Expected during New Game — finish the Lord of Hollows route.
achievements.summary: Climb down the broken Catacombs rope bridge into Smouldering Lake and defeat Old Demon King.

guide.context: Old Demon King is optional for story progression, but his soul supplies Chaos Bed Vestiges for the pyromancy collection.

steps.text: Cut the rope bridge before Wolnir, wait for it to collapse, climb down the hanging bridge, pass the Fire Demon to @loc{Smouldering Lake}, and defeat @enemy{Old Demon King} behind the near fog gate.

achievements.sortReason: Expected during New Game — finish the Lord of Hollows route.
achievements.summary: Take the left branch above the Dancer into Consumed King's Garden and defeat Oceiros.

guide.context: Oceiros blocks both Untended Graves and Path of the Dragon, making this optional boss the gateway to two location achievements.

steps.text: After the @enemy{Dancer}, climb the ladder, turn left into @loc{Consumed King's Garden}, descend through the toxic garden, pass the two Cathedral Knights, and defeat @enemy{Oceiros, the Consumed King}.

achievements.sortReason: Expected during New Game — finish the Lord of Hollows route.
achievements.summary: Enter Untended Graves and defeat Champion Gundyr in the mirrored tutorial arena.

guide.context: The boss soul is required for Prisoner's Chain, and the area beyond contains the Eyes of a Fire Keeper and several rings.

steps.text: Reveal the hidden path beyond Oceiros, reach @loc{Untended Graves}, follow the Cemetery of Ash route to the old arena, and defeat @enemy{Champion Gundyr}.

achievements.sortReason: Expected during New Game — finish the Lord of Hollows route.
achievements.summary: Run through the Ancient Wyvern arena, reach the high broken bridge, and land the plunging attack on the wyvern's head.

guide.context: Direct damage is unnecessary; the scripted plunge fails if the head moves during a roar, so wait for a stable alignment before dropping.

steps.text: Open the first large gate in @loc{Archdragon Peak}, enter the arena, run past the wyvern through the left ruins, climb the ladder near the far fog gate, follow the scaffolding to the broken bridge, and plunge onto @enemy{Ancient Wyvern}'s head.

achievements.sortReason: Expected during New Game — finish the Lord of Hollows route.
achievements.summary: Ring the Great Belfry bell and defeat King of the Storm followed by the Nameless King.

guide.context: No offline NPC summon is available, and the NG++ Covetous Gold Serpent Ring +2 requires a second late-cycle victory in this arena.

steps.text: Reach @loc{Great Belfry} in Archdragon Peak, ring the bell, cross the cloud path, enter the fog gate, defeat @enemy{King of the Storm}, and then defeat @enemy{The Nameless King}.

achievements.description: Light a bonfire flame for the first time.
achievements.sortReason: Expected during New Game — protect every questline.
achievements.summary: Light any bonfire, with the first Cemetery of Ash bonfire providing the earliest unlock.

guide.context: Lighting creates a travel checkpoint; resting is a separate action that also teaches the Rest gesture the first time.

steps.text: Follow the opening @loc{Cemetery of Ash} path to the first bonfire and choose Light Bonfire.

achievements.description: Become a Host of Embers for the first time.
achievements.sortReason: Expected during New Game — protect every questline.
achievements.summary: Enter Ember form for the first time, most directly by defeating Iudex Gundyr.

guide.context: The tutorial boss grants Ember form automatically, so no consumable Ember is required for the earliest unlock.

steps.text: Pull the Coiled Sword from @enemy{Iudex Gundyr} in Cemetery of Ash and defeat him; the victory changes the character into a Host of Embers and unlocks the achievement.
